result.note: Mostly context and opinion on ceasefire mediation; tested only the durable fact that Pakistan represents some Iranian diplomatic interests in Washington.

questions.prompt: As of April 2026, Iran had no embassy in Washington. Which country had represented some Iranian diplomatic interests there?
questions.explain: Pakistan has represented some Iranian diplomatic interests in Washington, where Tehran has no embassy. This, along with its long border with Iran, placed Pakistan better than India to broker a ceasefire between Iran and the US in April 2026.
questions.source: Pakistan has also represented some Iranian diplomatic interests in Washington, where Tehran has no embassy.
